03 / EDIT & AUDITION

Select a section

Handles retain neighboring source audio; they may contain other notes. Audition them before using them as pickups or tails. Loop playback uses the body only.

Sound shaping · saved per section

Changes glide over 120 ms during audition. The export can bake these settings or keep raw audio with effect instructions. Effects here do not change tempo.

04 / TRANSITION PLAYGROUND

Hear the handoff.

Uses the audio clock at the recorded BPM. Destination starts at its entry cue. Pickups can begin before the boundary; the source tail plays only when leaving at its loop ending. Trigger again after a handoff to test another destination.

Choose two sections to test a transition.
05 / EXPORT

Export your approved audio.

pulse-game-music.zip
This is an import destination in the guide, not a folder Pulse can write to.

Download ZIP

Your browser chooses the save location—usually Downloads, or a Save dialog if you enabled “Ask where to save.” Pulse cannot confirm where the file was saved. Unzip it to access your exported files.

Save or restore an editable loop plan

Use a plan JSON to reopen this work later. First load the matching original WAV, then browse for the plan. Audio is not embedded in the plan.

ZIP includes 16-bit WAV bodies, optional handle WAVs, a JSON manifest and setup notes for your selected engine. Loop points refer to decoded PCM samples, not milliseconds. This is an asset package with setup guidance, not an installed runtime integration. Plans reference the source audio; keep the matching WAV separately. This workspace prepares original-tempo assets; it does not bake the tempo-direction workspace.

03 / SCENE DIRECTION

Make the music meet the moment.

Each cue is an arrival target, measured in elapsed scene seconds. Pulse interpolates between cues. Time zero starts at the beginning of your audio. These targets control tempo, not the position of a chorus or source marker.

00:00.000
Scene time (s)DirectionIntensity (%)

Audition gameplay changes. New events redirect the music smoothly from its current speed.

During the hold, the latest event replaces the pending event. Beat/bar alignment uses the original BPM, assumes the file starts on beat one, and uses 4 beats per bar. This is a gameplay simulator, not an engine integration.

04 / REVIEW & DELIVERY

Keep the direction. Share the take.

WAV capture records playback in real time (up to 120 seconds), including pitch mode and listening volume. Start a cue timeline, sequence, or live performance while recording. Finish downloads a 16-bit stereo WAV at the browser audio sample rate. It is an audition take, not a sample-accurate film master. JSON includes cues, timing and settings; audio is not embedded.

Browser audition prototype · Not a Logic Audio Unit yet. Pitch preservation uses your browser’s audio engine; native plug-in sound quality still needs validation. Keep this tab visible during playback and capture. Browser scheduling is not sample-accurate. Native Logic AU, offline mastering, video sync, stem mixing and game middleware integration remain future work.
